director.text: 9 wala pizza

Haan, bilkul theek. 8/9 poore se bas 1/9 kam hai, 6/7 poore se 1/7 kam, aur 1/9 chhota hai. Ab poore paath ko yaad karke bas ek sawaal aur karna hai. Do ek jaisi patti hain: ek ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 7 liye, doosri ke 12 mein se 7. Kaunsa chhota hai, 7/10 ya 7/12?
Nahi, 12/7 theek nahi. Dono mein 7 hisse liye gaye; ab dekho kis patti ka ek hissa chhota hai. 7/10 aur 7/12, dono ek jaisi patti ke hain; inmein se chhota kaun hai?
12/7 se baat nahi bani. 12 bada number hai, par uska matlab hai ki patti zyada hisson mein kati, aur zyada hisson mein kati patti ka har hissa patla hota hai. Jo socha hai, woh bol do.
12/7 sahi nahi hai. Iska jawab hai 7/12, kyunki dono se 7 hisse liye, par 12 hisson wali patti ka har hissa chhota hai, isliye 7/12 chhota hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
maine pehle chhota wala socha, phir bada

Achha, sun liya maine. Aaj dekha ki ek hi poore ke jitne zyada barabar hisse hon, har hissa utna chhota hota hai. Phir dekha: neeche wala number same ho toh hisse ek size ke, aur hisson ki ginti faisla karti hai. Aakhir mein dekha: hisson ki ginti same ho, toh jiske hisse bade, wahi fraction zyada hota hai. Aaj ka kaam aasaan laga ya thoda mushkil?
thoda mushkil tha
Hmm, batane ke liye shukriya. Aaj ke paath mein tumne dekha ki 6/7 aur 8/9 mein poore ke zyada paas kaun. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge!
